Title: Welcome to Maine-yball
Text: This is the Weekly Digest, here you will find weekly talks about the top headlines of Maine Football throughout the course of the season.

Title: Preseason Buzz
Text: The 2026 season is almost here! After a long offseason, the teams are ready to hit the field and show what they have been working towards. Class A seems to be marked again with the same teams at the top, but there are a few new faces that could shake things up. Class B is looking to have a large transitional year across the league with the departure of a very talented 2026 class, leaving an exciting stage for the upcoming season for teams to step up and prove why they deserve to be in the conversation. Stay tuned for more updates as the season progresses!
